title: Compare posterior curves
description: You vary prevalence while keeping s_mean and c_mean fixed.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You create prevalence values across the supplied interval. These values supply the horizontal axis.
You compute disease probabilities after a positive test and after a negative test. Both calls receive the same prevalence values and the same s_mean and c_mean.

steps.question: What does the negative-test curve represent?
steps.answer: Its label is P(D=1 | T=-), the probability of disease given a negative test.

steps.description: You display both posterior curves on one set of axes. The legend identifies the test result associated with each curve.
